content.title: What channel is the Masters on? How to watch 2026 event at Augusta National
content.text: Fans will be keen to watch Bryson DeChambeau on TV at the 2026 Masters. Ben Jared/PGA TOUR via Getty Images The 2026 Masters starts Thursday, April 9, at Augusta National, and you can watch all four rounds on TV. But what channel is the Masters on? CBS and ESPN will be the TV channels carrying tournament coverage this year. Read below for complete information on watching the Masters.Masters TV schedule for 2026CBS and ESPN will provide exclusive TV coverage of the 2026 Masters, as the two TV channels have for years.MASTERS LIVE UPDATES: Follow Round 1 action at Augusta NationalESPN will air TV coverage for the the first two rounds on Thursday and Friday, in addition to Wednesday’s Masters Par 3 Contest. CBS will carry the broadcasts for the third and final rounds on Saturday and Sunday. Additionally, Amazon Prime Video will stream early coverage on Thursday and Friday, while Peacock+ will offer early streaming coverage on Masters Saturday and Sunday.You can view the complete 2026 Masters TV schedule below:Want to bet the Masters? Sign up for Fanatics Sportsbook with code “SUBPAR” to receive a special welcome offer.Wednesday, April 8 (Par 3 Contest): 2-4 p.m. (ESPN)Thursday, April 9: 1-3 p.m. ET (Prime Video); 3-7:30 p.m. (ESPN)Friday, April 10: 1-3 p.m. ET (Prime Video); 3-7:30 p.m. (ESPN)Saturday, April 11: 12-2 p.m. ET (Paramount+); 2-7 p.m. (CBS)Sunday, April 12: 12-2 p.m. ET (Paramount+); 2-7 p.m. (CBS)How can I stream the Masters?The 2026 Masters will be available to view online on several platforms.
